decisions.reason: As an older CD close to the core offer but without later visible support, it is likely to be judged against aspiration levels as a mature item whose resources can be better used elsewhere if demand is not clearly strong.

Because this illustrated release series builds on the firm’s established curation capabilities and exists as a multi-model line, management is likely to tolerate some uncertainty and keep it unless results clearly fall below aspiration.
A jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm’s reissue expertise and genre-broadening strategy, so in a growing market it is likely to meet or stay close enough to aspirations to remain on sale.
A multi-disc box set is costly, niche, and inventory-heavy, so if its performance is even modestly below aspiration the firm would likely redeploy resources to safer core catalog items.

Since this compilation CD received only limited website prominence and is easy to substitute with other catalog products, management would likely remove it if results are not clearly above aspiration.
